Claim 26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID or a salicylic acid NSAID, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and wherein therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved.

Claim 33 (Previously Presented): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin.

Claim 35 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 50 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and a salicylic acid NSAID, said salicylic acid NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylic acid NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5.

Claim 51 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
